run_beam_search_batch: run beam search batch to restore masked text using a forward pass function and model parameters
compute_attribution_saliency_maps: compute attribution saliency maps for subregions and dates from model gradients and character embeddings
sequential_restoration_saliency: generate per-step saliency maps based on a text history trajectory from sequential decoding
calculate_date_loss_l1_twoside: calculate two-sided L1 loss between predicted and target date ranges
replace_mask_idx_with_unk: replace masked character positions in text with unknown markers and return adjusted indices
